clips.title: The story
paras: In Felwood, a Filled Cursed Ooze Jar holds a sample for Laris Geardawdle in Ironforge. The gnome scholar seeks the ancient origins of slimes across Azeroth.

Laris Geardawdle, a gnome researcher, sees mystery where most adventurers see vile puddles and caustic slimes. Slimes thrive in many places, and Forsaken apothecaries gather them with care. Those sights led Geardawdle to a bold theory: oozes may be primordial secretions bound to Azeroth's creation. To gather a sample, brave Felwood's blighted woods, defeat a cursed ooze, and scoop its acidic remains into an empty jar before they dissolve.

Laris Geardawdle hopes his ooze samples will bring both knowledge and a lasting name. A major discovery could secure his reputation in the dwarven-led Explorers' League. Since Gnomeregan fell, many gnome refugees in Ironforge feel pressed to prove their worth to their dwarven hosts. Geardawdle believes that uncovering the ancient secrets of ooze will show them that welcoming gnomes was no mistake.
